methodology.overallScore: 60% normalized original reviewer star rating and 40% extracted overall-satisfaction sentiment. Both components require at least five reviews.
methodology.aggregation: Repeated claims are averaged within each review before review-level results are combined.
methodology.minimumEvidence: Findings require at least five distinct reviews.
methodology.limitations: Retailer reviews are self-selected and may not represent every CPAP patient. Text findings were extracted by an AI model and are not medical advice.
